assumptions.text: A1. This review is a drafting and analysis aid prepared by AI. It is not legal advice or a filing decision; qualified patent counsel signs off before anything is filed.
A2. The absence of intake/priority/ is read as 'no priority document supplied', not as a confirmation that no earlier filing exists.

open_questions.text: Q1. Is there any earlier application (for example a provisional or national first filing) from which this application will claim priority? If so, supply it under intake/priority/ so that Prompt 31 can be run against it; if not, confirm that this is the first filing.
